_meta.updated: 2026-06-23 — status corrected to 'paused' (activation gated on canary pass + 2nd board go); api trigger added for manual test firing
_meta.auth_note: Agents can only create routines assigned to themselves. The Monitor agent (4bd33af1) can create its own routine, but it has no scheduled heartbeat to do so. CTO (manager) or CEO/board-operator must create it. Coder (3ab7fa06) cannot create routines for other agents.

routine_payload.title: Failover Monitor tick
routine_payload.description: Wake the Failover Monitor every ~5 min to scan for cloud IC agents stalled on usage/session limits. Failover eligible issues to local understudies per PAIRING-MAP.json. Delivery-only: all decision logic lives in the Monitor agent per the INSTRUCTIONS.md algorithm (4 gates, FAILOVER-HANDOFF comment, reassign). See SAG-4590 design and SAG-4573 board approval d21e8b5e.

triggers.label: manual-test-trigger
triggers.note: Add FIRST. Lets CTO fire a test run manually: POST /api/routines/{routineId}/run {source: 'manual'}. Verify Monitor boots on Qwen3.6, scans issues, exits with a summary comment. No stalled issues expected on first run — a clean no-op exit is the correct success signal.

triggers.label: 5-min failover scan
triggers.note: Add AFTER manual test passes. Still leave routine status=paused until 2nd board go.

creation_steps: 3. POST /api/routines/{routineId}/triggers with triggers[0] (api trigger) — capture triggerId
4. POST /api/routines/{routineId}/triggers with triggers[1] (schedule trigger) — capture triggerId
5. Manual test: POST /api/routines/{routineId}/run {source: 'manual'} — Monitor wakes, scans, exits
6. Report routineId + triggerIds + run result back to SAG-4613 via comment
7. Leave status=paused until canary passes + 2nd board go

activation_gate.requirement: PATCH routine status='active' ONLY after: (1) manual test run clean, (2) SAG-4613 3-run canary passes, (3) CEO issues 2nd board go for fleet-wide rollout.

canary_pairing.reason: Board-recommended. Same-department SWE pair. Verifies full cycle: detect → tier-gate → FAILOVER-HANDOFF → understudy continuation → FAILOVER-RETURN → cloud review.

no_failover_test.description: Negative test: confirm sensitivity gate (Gate C) blocks auto-failover on marked issues.
no_failover_test.test_approach: Create a test issue with 'NO-FAILOVER' in title or description, assign to a cloud IC agent in the pairing map, fire Monitor via api trigger. Verify Monitor posts FAILOVER-ESCALATION comment and does NOT reassign.
no_failover_test.expected_outcome: Issue remains assigned to original cloud agent; no FAILOVER-HANDOFF posted.

rollout_gate.fleet_wide_requirement: 2nd explicit board go per SAG-4613 HARD gate. Do not extend PAIRING-MAP or activate for non-canary pairings without CEO + board sign-off.
